title: JSON Schema in, form out
text: Draft 2020-12 keywords: types, required, enums, ranges, lengths, patterns, formats, arrays, and nested objects.

title: Real AbsoluteUI controls
text: Fields are Text Input, Select, Date Picker, and friends inside Form, so validation and the Error Summary work as usual.

title: UI schema
text: Widgets, order, columns, help text, placeholders, and safe JSON visibility conditions without eval.

title: Arrays with the keyboard
text: Add, remove, and reorder entries with buttons; every change is announced.

title: Typed JSON and pointers
text: getValue() returns typed JSON; server errors map back with setErrors by JSON Pointer.

title: Strict by design
text: Unsupported keywords are configuration errors with their pointers, never silently ignored.
